messages:
alex: Cost review flagged high spend on our spot GPU pools. Want a quick sync — how are we picking multi-instance-type pools to balance price + eviction + perf? Cross-AZ constraints are biting us.
marta: Agree. Start with a scoring function. e.g. `score = w_price*norm_price + w_ev*eviction_rate + w_perf*perf_delta`. Lower is better. Kickoff weights: w_price=0.5, w_ev=0.3, w_perf=0.2.
chen: Also include network locality and NVLINK availability. Some models lose >10% perf on certain SKUs — treat that as disqualifying.
sam: Ops note: keep a tiny warm standby (on-demand/dedicated) pool per-AZ to absorb preemptions. Also shorten checkpoint interval for long runs. Example config snippet:
```
warm_pool:
  size_per_az: 2
  policy: keep-warm
checkpoint:
  interval_minutes: 5
```
infra-bot: auto-scaler alert: replaced 12 preempted GPUs in us-west-2a in the last 10m; avg replacement latency 47s.
jules: On bin-packing, fragmentation is the killer. Recommendation: avoid >2 GPU family generations inside a single nodegroup. Instead use heterogeneous nodegroups with family-aligned packing and a vGPU-equivalence binning. Pack by bin id, not raw GPU type.
marta: Also run a 7-day simulation using historical eviction traces + price traces. If predicted eviction risk >8% during business hours, promote that type into a "stable" lane (favor lower eviction even if price +10%).
alex: For immediate mitigation: reduce allowed GPU generations in the spot-pool config to 2 and enable warm_pool. I'll open an RFC + perf tests. @marta @jules can you draft sim parameters? :thumbsup:
sam: I'll add a fallback routing rule for critical low-latency models: route to dedicated nodes when predicted queue depth >500 qps or when eviction prob > threshold.
chen: Add a new metric we can show in console: `prefetch_success_rate` per-instance-type over 1h window. If <0.98 mark type as suspect and remove from eligible pool automatically.
alex: Cool. Schedule 30m sync tomorrow to finalize weights and rollout plan. Action items: RFC, sim job, warm_pool toggle, metric dashboard. Thanks everyone.
